text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Yui is asked to go shopping by her childhood friend, Makoto.
She makes a shopping list while they chat.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──ユイは幼なじみのマコトに買い出しを頼まれ、
彼女と話しながら買う物をリストにまとめていた。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Makoto, are these all the groceries you want me to buy?
text_block_list.orig_text:
マコトちゃん。
買ってきて欲しい食材は、
これで全部だよね？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, thanks.
Oh yeah, you should ask [i]him[/i] to go with you. I hear there's a gang of
bandits haunting the highway these days, so it's a good excuse, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
よろしくな。
そうだ。
どうせならアイツと一緒に行ってこいよ。
最近盗賊団が街道に出るらしいから、
ちょうどいいだろ？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really...?
...Then I might as well invite him to tag along.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうなんだ……
……じゃあ、せっかくだし
誘ってみようかな。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
What's up with you today?
You're unusually enthusiastic.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうしたんだよユイ。
珍しく乗り気になったな。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
You think so?
It's just that I want to make lots more memories with Mr. Knight...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう？　
わたしはただ、
騎士クンとの思い出を
もっとたくさん作りたいなって思って……

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Is that so...? That's the spirit, Yui.
Now, get going!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっか……
いい顔してるぜ、ユイ。
行ってきな！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Makoto. Off I go.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとう、マコトちゃん。
行ってきます。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Mr. Knight, thanks for always helping me out.
It's not just Makoto's groceries I have to get,
but the whole guild's, so I can't do it alone.
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士クン。
いつもありがとう。
マコトちゃんから頼まれた分もあるんだけど、
ギルドのみんなの食材もあるから、
一人じゃ大変で──

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. These days I'm able to converse with him normally.
In the past, I was so nervous that I couldn't speak to him at all...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ、
最近は騎士クンと
普段通りお話できてる。
昔は緊張して、
全然話せてなかったのに……

text_block_list.text: Guaaahhhhhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ぐあああああっ！！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Was that... a scream just now?
choice_data_list: Let's head to where it came from!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今の……
悲鳴だったよね？

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: Everybody, run! I'll take care of them...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな逃げろ！　
こいつらは俺が……！

text_block_list.name: Bandit 1
text_block_list.text:
What heroic garbage are ya tryin' to pull?
Just hand over whatcha got!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんな構え方で俺たちに勝てると思ってんのか？
大人しく荷物と金を渡せ！

text_block_list.name: Bandit 2
text_block_list.text: What's it gonna be? Yer money, or yer life!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうすりゃ
命だけは助けてやる！

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: I knew I should've stayed at home...
text_block_list.orig_text: なんでこんなことに……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Those people over there are the bandits Makoto was talking about...
choice_data_list: Protect the people from the bandits.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの人たち、
マコトちゃんがいってた盗賊団だ……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Let me help!
Everyone, please get out of here! We'll handle this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わたしも一緒に！
みなさん、逃げてください！　
ここはわたしたちが！

text_block_list.name: Bandit 1
text_block_list.text:
Who the hell're they? They still got backup?
You, go mess 'em up! Let 'em get away an' I'll eat yer eyes fer dinner!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだアイツら……
まだ連れがいたのか。
おい、
捕まえてこい！　
逃げるなら容赦はするな！

text_block_list.name: Bandit 2
text_block_list.text: I'll sort 'em out!
text_block_list.orig_text: まかせろ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
I'll stop these cretins with my magic, so you go ahead and save the
people who are being attacked!
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔法で足止めするから、
騎士クンは先に
襲われてる人たちを！

text_block_list.name: Bandit 2
text_block_list.text: Not so fast!
text_block_list.orig_text: させるかっ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Urk!
text_block_list.orig_text: きゃっ！

text_block_list.name: Bandit 2
text_block_list.text:
Ya think ya can restrict my movements with magic?
Pathetic! Hyaaa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔法で動きをおさえようって考えか？
甘ぇよ！　
おらぁっ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Mr. Knight!
text_block_list.orig_text: 騎士クン！

text_block_list.name: Bandit 2
text_block_list.text: Heh. Tryin' to be a knight in shinin' armor, protectin' the princess?
text_block_list.orig_text:
へっ、
お姫様を守るナイト様のつもりか？

text_block_list.name: Bandit 3
text_block_list.text: Havin' trouble holdin' yer sword?! Hurry up and take his head off!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なに手こずってんだ！　
さっさと終わらせるぞ！

text_block_list.name: Bandit 2
text_block_list.text:
I'll admit, yer no slouch...
But I wonder how long ya can keep it up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
少しはやるじゃねぇか……
だが
いつまでそうしてられるだろうなっ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Mr. Knight, get back! I'll block his attacks with magic!
At this rate, you're...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士クン下がって！　
攻撃は魔法で防ぐから！
このままだと騎士クンが……！

text_block_list.name: Bandit 3
text_block_list.text:
Like hell I'd let that girl hidin' behind ya cast spells!
I'll put an end to this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
後ろの女に
魔法なんぞ使わせるわけねぇだろ！
これで終わりだっ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
choice_data_list: I'll protect you, no matter what.
text_block_list.orig_text: ああっ……！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Mr. Knight...!
text_block_list.orig_text: 騎士クン……！

text_block_list.name: Bandit 3
text_block_list.text: Tsk! You're one stubborn bastard...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちっ！　
しぶとい野郎だ……！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
It's always like this... I'm always being protected by him...
Whether it's in my dreams or in real life! ...I have to change!
I don't want him to get hurt anymore than he already has been...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いつもこうだ……
わたしは、
騎士クンに守られてばっかり……
夢の中でも、
今だって……！　
……変わるんだ！
騎士クンにはこれ以上、
傷ついて欲しくない……！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
I won't... hesitate any longer!
I don't want to lose the person I love!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わたしは……
もう迷わない！
大好きな人を、
失いたくないから！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Hold on, Mr. Knight... I'm going to save you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
待ってて、騎士クン……
今助けるね！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
I've never used this magic before... but if I'm afraid,
I'll never be able to protect the people I care about! That's why I...
text_block_list.orig_text:
初めて使う魔法だけど……
そんなことを怖がってたら、
大切な人を守れなくなる……！　
だから、
わたしは……！

text_block_list.name: Bandit 2
text_block_list.text:
Ya think ya can burn us to ashes, do ya?!
Come an' have a go, if ya think yer hard enough!
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔法でコイツごと焼き払う気か！
やれるもんならやってみろ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: I'll unleash my power to support and protect Mr. Knight...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの人を支え、
守るための力を解き放つ……！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: O Light! Be the radiance of judgement that pierces the stars!
text_block_list.orig_text:
光よ！　
星をも穿つ、
断罪の輝きとなれ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Goooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: いっけぇぇぇぇっ！！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Shooting Star!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──シューティングスター！！！

text_block_list.name: Bandits
text_block_list.text: Waaaaaahhhhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: うわああああああっ！！

text_block_list.name: Bandit 2
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not possible!
It's only targetin' us!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんな馬鹿な！
俺たちだけを、
的確に──！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
The power to make sure the people I care about don't get hurt is mine...
This is my full power...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大切な人たちが
傷つかなくていいようにする力……
これが
わたしの全力だよ……！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Mr. Knight! Are you okay?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士クン！　
大丈夫！？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
That's a deep wound... Your pulse is getting weak!
Stay with me. I [i]will[/i] save you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひどい傷……
鼓動が小さくなってる！
待っててね。
必ず助けるから！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Flowering Heal!
text_block_list.orig_text: フラワリングヒール！！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Even if it means sacrificing my own life...
I'll give everything I've got so that Mr. Knight can live!
text_block_list.orig_text:
たとえ
命を失ってもいい！
わたしの全部を使って、
騎士クンを救う！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
So make him open his eyes...
I beg you...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから
目を覚まして……
お願い……！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
I've staunched the flow of blood...
I'll take care of the bruises later...
So all that's left for now is to repair the laceration!
text_block_list.orig_text:
出血は抑えられた……
打撲は後回しにして、
次は裂傷を塞がなきゃ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: You're going to be okay, Mr. Knight...
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう大丈夫だからね、
騎士クン……

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: ...Are you sure you don't need to come with us?
text_block_list.orig_text: ……私たちと一緒に行かなくていいんですか？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sure. We'll stay here until I've finished treating these wounds.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……はい。
わたしたちは、
治療が終わるまでここにいます。

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Okay, we'll get going then...
Thank you. Thank you ever so much...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
では、
私たちはこれで……
本当に、
ありがとうございました……！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Farewell...!
text_block_list.orig_text: さようなら～……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
...Have you come to? No need to worry anymore.
All of the bandits have been caught and are being taken back to the city.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
気がついた？　
もう大丈夫だよ。
盗賊の人たちは全員捕まえて、
街に連れて行ってもらったの。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: And I'm almost done with your medical treatment, so hold on two secs.
text_block_list.orig_text:
治療もあと少しで終わるから、
ちょっとだけ待ってて。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
...Even when you're gravely wounded, you come to my rescue.
Thank you. But the version of me who always needs your help
won't be here much longer.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……傷だらけになっても、
わたしを守ってくれて、
ありがとう。
もう守ってもらってばかりのわたしじゃ
なくなるから。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
From now on, I'll do my best to ensure that we can protect each other.
You can count on it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これからは騎士クンと、
お互いに守り合えるように
頑張るね。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
...All right, I've completed your treatment.
You should be able to move now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……はい、
治療は終わり。
もう動いても平気だよ。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Oh, don't worry about it.
I just did what I could...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ううん、
気にしないで。
わたしにできることをやっただけだから……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
...My eyes are welling up... What? Why...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あれ？
……涙が……
あれ、
あれ……？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
It's so strange...
The tears just won't stop...
text_block_list.orig_text:
おかしいな……
全然、
止まってくれない……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: *sniff, sniff*...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅぅ……
ぐすっ……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... Mr. Knight...
I was so scared...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぐすっ……
騎士クン……
わたし、
ずっと怖かった……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
You were attacked so viciously...
And you were down and out.
I thought that was it—that you'd never move again...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あのまま攻撃されて……
騎士クンが倒れたまま、
動かなくなるんじゃないかって……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: I was terrified...
text_block_list.orig_text: 怖かったよぉ……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Th-...
...Thank you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ……
……ありがとう。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Your hand is so warm...
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士クンの手、
あったかい……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: ...Is it my imagination, or is his face getting closer and closer...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……気のせいかな、
騎士クンの顔が、
どんどん近くなってる……？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Mr. Knight...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士、
くん……？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
This is the first time we've locked eyes so close to each other...
It totally feels like we're about to kiss...
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんなに近くで見つめ合うなんて、
初めてだよ……
まるでこのまま、
キス
しちゃいそうになるくらい……

text_block_list.name: Yui
choice_data_list: Wait to see if her tears have stopped.

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
...I'm so confused.
I have no idea when I should open my eyes...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……どうしよう、
目を開けていいタイミングが分かんない……！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Heeey! Yui!
You okay?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おーい！　
ユイー！
大丈夫かー！？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Uwehh?!
Ah! I-it's Makoto!
...Ahem. Over here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぇっ！？
あっ！　
マ、
マコトちゃんだ！
……こほん。
こっちだよー！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
I was worried when I heard you got attacked by bandits!
You all right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
盗賊団に襲われたって聞いて心配したぞ！
無事か？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm totally fine!
...Mr. Knight was protecting me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん！　
わたしは大丈夫！
……騎士クンが、
守ってくれたから。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
I see...!
Good job, {0}!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうか……！
よくやったな、{0}！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
...If Makoto hadn't just shown up,
I wonder if Mr. Knight and I...
would've ended up kissing...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……もしもマコトちゃんがこなかったら、
あのままわたし、
騎士クンと……
キス、
しちゃってたのかな……？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Yui? You sure you're okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ユイ？　
ホントに大丈夫か？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Huh?!
Ah, yeah! Nothing wrong at all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ！？
あっ、うん！　
大丈夫だよ？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Good to hear. I'm glad you're fine.
...Did you two get along well?
I bet you made some good memories.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ならいいんだ。
とにかく無事で良かったよ。
……ちゃんと仲良くなれたのか？
思い出、
作ってきたんだろ？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Memories... Definitely. But it's not like anything good happened,
so I wouldn't exactly call them good memories...
But today was certainly unforgettable.
text_block_list.orig_text:
思い出……
なのかな。
いいことがあったわけじゃないから、
そう言っていいのかは分からないけど……
今日のことは、
ずっと忘れられないと思う。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Makoto, for giving me the courage I needed.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとう、
マコトちゃん。
わたしに勇気をくれて。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Anytime! I'm happy for you, Yui!
Let's go grab a bite to eat! You're coming too, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おう！　
良かったな、ユイ！
じゃあ飯でも食べに行こうぜ！　
おまえも来るだろ？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
...What? You've got work to do?
I wanted to squeeze all the juicy details out of you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なんだよ、
仕事か。
根掘り葉掘り聞きたかったのに。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Please, Makoto, not now...
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう、
マコトちゃんってば……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: ...Mr. Knight! Thank you for everything you do... See you soon!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
騎士クン！　
いつもありがとう……
またね！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Mr. Knight... No matter how badly or how many times you're hurt,
I'll heal you up. Because if you're happy, then I can be happy too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士クン……
わたしね、
どんなに騎士クンが傷ついても、
何度でも治すよ。
騎士クンが笑顔でいてくれたら、
わたしも笑顔でいられるから……！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: But one day, I know... I'll be able to put a smile on your face!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもいつか、
きっといつか……
わたしが騎士クンを
笑顔にしてあげられるようになるね！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
As she watched {0}'s figure disappear into the
distance, Yui gained a little bit of self-confidence knowing that she
had saved him for once.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ユイは{0}の背中を見送りながら、
主人公を救えたことでほんの少しだけ自信を得たのだった──
